name: Stephanie Adwell
source:
A fairly new policy officer working for the city of London. 

She is one of the main potential romance interests for the main character. 

She is currently living with her longtime roommate Marissa. 

Stephanie is an avid soccer and racing fan and can bond with the main character over there shared interests in soccer.  

Note: Stephanie has some dark things going on with her life and you should except to be confronted with disturbing themes if you proceed with her romance path. 

[spoiler]Her father is in jail for raping one of Stephanie's elementary school friends during a sleepover at Stephanie's home. This occurred when Stephanie was a child.[spoiler]

[spoiler]Marissa weaponizes the event against Stephanie, during their relationship, as part of Marissa's ongoing control tactics and abuse against Stephanie.[spoiler]
